# UX audit roll-up — checkout flow

**Access:** unauthenticated — the handoff was declined, so the signed-in cart and order
history were not reached. The counts below cover the public half of the flow only.

## Highest-priority finding

**[P0] Checkout submit does nothing on first tap** — usability, Nielsen #1. The button
reports no pending state and the request is swallowed; a second tap succeeds, so the
failure is silent. No workaround a user would discover.
See [the usability report](usability-20261111-143000.md).

## Merged issues by priority

1. **[P0]** Checkout submit does nothing on first tap — usability
2. **[P1]** Payment button has no visible keyboard focus — usability
3. **[P1]** Card number input has no label — accessibility
4. **[P1]** Error summary is not announced to screen readers — accessibility
5. **[P1]** Promo-code field rejects valid codes with no message — usability
